summary: Phase 1.5 backend testing complete. Added 13 new pytest cases covering AI Health Score, 4 Excel export endpoints, and S3 upload skeleton (status + image upload + validation). All 45 tests pass (100%) - 32 regression + 13 new. MongoDB Atlas migration verified working (all previous endpoints still operational). S3 upload correctly returns 503 'S3 not configured' when AWS keys are empty (expected per spec). Excel files are valid XLSX with correct sheets, content-type, and Content-Disposition.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_extras.py health-score endpoint loops all products + per-product stocks query in Python - acceptable for 20 products but will become N+1 at scale. Consider a single aggregation pipeline if product count grows past a few hundred.

routes_extras.py uses raw ObjectId(outlet_id) in the optional outlet_id branch without validation - a malformed id will throw bson.errors.InvalidId raising 500 instead of 400. Wrap in try/except and return HTTP 400.
s3_utils.upload_bytes reads S3_BUCKET_NAME via os.environ[...] (KeyError if absent) - acceptable since is_configured() gates it, but defensive .get() with explicit 503 would be cleaner.
Date filtering uses ISO string comparison via $gte on created_at; works because seed stores ISO strings, but indices and timezone handling would benefit from true datetime storage.
Excel exports load entire datasets into memory (to_list(100000)). Fine for current demo (291 bills) but stream-based generation recommended for large tenants.
Health Score 'tax_compliance' metric is essentially a constant 100 whenever any bill has tax_total > 0 - feels too lenient; consider proper filed-return tracking.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md - all 4 demo accounts authenticate successfully against MongoDB Atlas.
seed_data_creation: Existing TEST_-prefixed data continues to accumulate on each run (registered businesses, products, customers, suppliers, POs). No teardown done.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Phase 1.5 tests live at the bottom of backend_test.py (after line 414). When AWS keys are added to backend/.env, the test test_upload_image_returns_503_when_s3_not_configured will START FAILING - it must be updated to expect 200 + a real S3 URL (or split into two tests gated by an env check). Demo data: 3 outlets, 20 products, 291 bills, 8 customers in MongoDB Atlas DB 'retailflow_ai'.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
